every dash and colon variant → - and :
list numbers like 1. or Step 3: removed
pieces with no letters or digits skipped
join every sentence's tokens in order
value on this line or the next
pull out dates, times, weekdays and numbers

the math inside the bracket gets its own tokens

keep only the first math-in-words op

written math: both sides as written
in words: "X to Y" → X, Y; else date, amount
if several fit, the earlier one wins
